name: foliodash
description: A private portfolio tracker for Mac and Android.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:contributors && npm run verify:punctuation && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:apps-script
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project config/tsconfig.json && tsc --project config/tsconfig.web.json && tsc --project config/tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config --config config/eslint.config.ts src tests scripts config/eslint.config.ts
